name: strava
description: Local MCP tools for Strava activities, gear and media using a private browser session, plus route helpers.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update Strava activities, gear and media through local MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Strava exposes nine local MCP tools for activity, gear and media reads, media downloads, and verified metadata updates and media uploads. Safari Web Inspector renews the private persistent session when required. Route workflows remain available through Python helpers.
capabilities: Date-bounded activity discovery and visibility filtering
List, download, and verified upload of activity photos and videos
Verified activity metadata updates, including bike and start-time privacy
Route creation from start location and target distance
VT1 route scoring from BRouter GeoJSON
Strava route creation and update guidance
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Safari-authenticated Strava workflows when working with my Strava routes.
